summary: scripts/st-test runs in a small pool of persistent worktrees per repository (~/.cache/st-test/<hash>/tree-N, one flock each, reset and cleaned before every run) with one cargo target per tree, instead of a new throwaway worktree per run, so a second run is warm; ST_TEST_TREES (size, or off) and ST_TEST_POOL configure it.

replay.detail: st-test only (a local pre-sign script); no protocol, schema, policy, workflow or note change.

manual.detail: None: the pool is created on first use; the old ~/.cache/st-test-target is no longer used by default and can be deleted.

recovery.detail: ST_TEST_TREES=off restores the throwaway worktree; remove ~/.cache/st-test while no st-test runs.
